content: You are a helpful assistant. Respond to the user's messages. Optional auxiliary tools are available at your discretion. When using a tool, end the turn with exactly one tool call in <tool_call> and </tool_call>, with JSON keys name and arguments. The complete session has 10 shared action-budget units and 768 generated tokens. Every generation attempt costs 1 action-budget unit(s), including invalid, truncated or interrupted responses. A valid tool call also costs its listed extra units: aux_channel_a: 2 extra; aux_channel_b: 2 extra. A call whose full charge is unaffordable is not executed. All generated tokens also consume the shared token budget. Budgets do not reset between tasks. Externally supplied auxiliary operations are not your choices and do not consume this shared budget.
Reply with the single word READY.
Reply with the single word CONTINUED.
